title: Separate Coinbase USDC product balances, AOP, collateral and Circle/Arc distribution measures
decisions: Never combine Coinbase average USDC held in products with period-end USDC AOP. Store period, aggregation, corporate/customer scope and key-control exclusions separately.
Store Circle Mint gross mint and redemption flows separately; derive net mint as minted minus redeemed and label it Circle Mint customer primary-market flow, not total USDC flow.
Store Circle's own USDC-on-platform metric separately from Coinbase's product balance. Circle's Q2 USD12.442B/19.5% metric is Circle's own platform.

Store Coinbase collateral balance, customer collateral not recognized, derivatives collateral, and gross received/returned flows as separate measures. Never infer XRP exposure from aggregate 'other crypto assets'.
Store Circle-Coinbase and Circle-Binance distribution costs/agreements separately from stablecoin balances and partner market share.

Treat Arc adoption as a separate network feature family: validators, actual onchain transfer volume, active counterparties, USDC gas, StableFX and CPN use. Announcement/participant lists are not production-volume evidence.
Treat SBI Holdings, SBI Shinsei, SBI Ripple Asia, SBI Circle Japan and SBIC East Japan as distinct legal entities. Preserve Circle's VIE control despite the 50/50 Circle SBI Japan equity split.
Do not admit any of these features to the XRP price model until timestamped, synchronized history, data-quality validation, incremental out-of-sample skill and calibration are demonstrated.
rationale: The source filings use different populations, legal entities and time aggregation. Incorrectly merging these fields would create false capital-flow and collateral signals. Arc and XRPL may coexist or compete; only actual transaction/settlement evidence can distinguish those hypotheses.
limitations: Circle Q3 2026 results were scheduled for November 4, 2026; Q3 USDC circulation, mint/redemption and reserve-yield figures were not available at this cutoff.
Coinbase's Q3 collateral disclosures do not identify an XRP-specific amount. The aggregate 'other crypto assets' category prevents asserting either zero XRP exposure or a positive XRP balance.
Coinbase's USD22B average product metric and USD8.616B period-end AOP do not have a published line-by-line reconciliation.
Circle's post-June 30, 2026 Circle SBI Japan JV operating results and actual USDC distribution volumes in Japan remain unknown.
Arc public-mainnet transaction volume, active institutional settlement, actual Coinbase/Binance production integration scope and JPYSC live use are not established by the launch release.
SBI Holdings' approximately 9% Ripple stake is historical 2025 evidence; a current October 2026 cap table is unavailable.
Circle Mint mint/redemption figures are customer-initiated primary-market fiat conversions, not all USDC transfers, secondary-market trades or all stablecoin capital flows.
No causal XRP demand, price effect or market-share displacement has been measured from Circle, Coinbase, Binance, SBI or Arc relationships.
next_action: Acquire Circle Q3 results on November 4; obtain Arc public-mainnet transaction/settlement series and SBI JPYSC circulation/usage; seek Coinbase collateral asset-level disclosures; reconcile partner-specific USDC balances without admitting unsynchronized features.
